summary: Exited on the first bar where all four fire detectors (KMDR, CLIMAX, HA, PROPP) aligned against the position simultaneously, coinciding with price slipping back to roughly breakeven (-0.25pts) after a 55% giveback of the leg's amplitude and a prior peak of +26.75pts. Earlier partial-against readings (2-3 of 4 detectors) were treated as noise and held through, consistent with the graveyard finding that cutting winners early or on partial giveback loses money -- but full 4/4 confluence was the first genuinely new signature in the episode. Next time I'd want to see whether unanimous multi-detector confluence like this has a validated hit-rate/edge on turn timing (vs. TURN-CLIMAX alone), and whether waiting one more bar for confirmation before EXIT would have avoided false positives when only 3/4 align.
